claim: A sector open to the sky holds its ceiling at least as high as any roofed neighbour's: otherwise the upper wall is drawn and daylight shows below the surrounding roofline. Over the 43 campaign maps, of 1348 open-sector/roofed-neighbour pairs the sky stands higher in 1338 (median 32768, about two bodies), equal in 6, and lower in 4, all of them in E3M4.
evidence: knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_sky_below_roof.py over the 43 campaign maps (pairs as bloodmap/rules_blood.py rule 'sky-is-never-below-a-roof'): 1348 pairs, 1338 higher, 6 equal, 4 lower (E3M4)
NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:4688 (classicDrawBunches) draws the upper wall whenever either side is roofed
use: Run the rule on a built map; a doorway from a room to a yard keeps the yard's sky at or above the room's ceiling.

checked.how: Recounted with knowledge/blood/findings/probes/audit2_sky_below_roof.py, pairing as rules_blood._sky_is_never_below_a_roof does (portal_graph, open sector vs roofed neighbour) over 43 campaign maps: 1348 pairs, equal 6 (0.4%), sky higher 1338, sky lower 4 (all E3M4), median gap 32768 with the sky higher. engine.cpp:4688 (classicDrawBunches) draws the upper wall when either side is roofed.
